proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 5078 article gives Malayalam mel slender, tender; meliyuka to grow thin, lean; melivu, meliccal thinness, leanness; melluka, mellikka to be thin, fine; mellē slowly, gently, softly.. The Malayalam survey form meliñña “thin” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
